limitations: Exact commuting modal blocks with identity leading SPD blocks, positive modal couplings and common positive secondary coupling only.

Minimizes spectral radius of unit-step stationary preconditioned Richardson for scalar Schur block Q=qI; does not optimize GMRES, finite-step norm, costs, arbitrary Schur approximations or noncommuting systems.
Repeated roots can be defective, so polynomial prefactors are not excluded by the asymptotic radius guarantee.
scientific_integrity: The finite numerical checker supplements a complete analytic proof. The result is not claimed to have undergone independent mathematical validation. Historical priority may include unindexed scalar parameter analyses.
title: Unique scalar Schur tuning for modal double-saddle-point Richardson iteration
